'''Omacala''' was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Omacala ran the [[Umbra Club]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and nightclub situated within [[Sector 1459]] of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], and he paid a lot of attention to the activities and conversations of the cantina's patrons. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Omacala encountered a band of [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] operatives who were seeking to track down the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]], and in return for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], he supplied them with some information. He was, however, reluctant to discuss the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in detail.<ref name="UABS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The player characters can ask Omacala the following questions: "What do you know about Black Sun?", "What do you know about Kaa'to Leeachos?", "What do you know about Speng?", and "Who is Coruum Sa'dia?" Depending on their success rate, he will provide them with various bits of information needed to track down Leeachos.<ref name="UABS" />
